video_title: LIVE REACTION to Knicks’ 20-8 run to end the 1st half of Game 3 🔥 | Pat McAfee NBA Finals Altcast

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby's defensive versatility and impact at the five position
quotes.excerpt: OG Anunoby is at the five position. Now, big time three with a big time block.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I want y'all to look at the lineup that Mike Brown has on the floor right now for the New York Knicks. OG Anunoby is at the five position. Now, big time three with a big time block. And OG Anunoby has had success over the course of his career of going against Victor Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' small-ball strategy to counter Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: You know how you get Wembanyama out the paint? You go small.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: This is what you call small ball lineup. You know how you get Wembanyama out the paint? You go small. Put five guards, wings around the paint, outside the perimeter and pull him outside the paint.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's playmaking and feeding the seven-foot-four format
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox says you got it Kyrie and feeds this seven-foot-four format.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: The Spurs could use a De'Aaron Fox sight. De'Aaron Fox says you got it Kyrie and feeds this seven-foot-four format.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Referee ruling on the Jalen Brunson foul review
quotes.excerpt: It's been determined that there was no unnecessary contact and none of the criteria of a flagrant foul.
quotes.quote: On review, it's been determined that there was no unnecessary contact and none of the criteria of a flagrant foul present themselves, as there is no wind up with the speed, no impact, and no follow through. This is a common foul with a penalty of two shots.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's defensive evolution and impact
quotes.excerpt: You wouldn't have saw this version of Karl-Anthony Towns two, three months ago.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: The way that he's playing on the defensive side of the basketball, you wouldn't have saw this version of Karl-Anthony Towns two, three months ago.

text_blocks.speaker: Pat McAfee
text_blocks.text: Huge, huge from Fox there, who we would not have seen two games ago, maybe a series ago.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's challenge to Karl-Anthony Towns after Game 1
quotes.excerpt: Excellent game one, but can you do it three more times?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: The one thing that Mike Brown always harp on when they challenge Karl-Anthony Towns after Game 1, they told him they said, 'Excellent game one, but can you do it three more times?' And they challenge him to be that guy that's losing himself in the team.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's coaching adjustments and sideline battle
quotes.excerpt: It's a battle of the sidelines as well.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Stephon Castle playing with force, getting stops. They got to find a way. Mitch Johnson got to get into his bag. The one thing we can't say about Mike Brown, like we saw Jordan Clarkson sighting, he's not afraid to throw something out there. And he's not afraid to make adjustments. Mike Brown has been coaching his ass off and it's showing. It's a battle of the sidelines as well.

text_blocks.speaker: Pat McAfee
text_blocks.text: Yeah, Alvarado comes in, Clarkson comes in. They go 16-5 without Brunson, then Brunson comes back in and gets hot.
